parsed.post: Improved val_bpb to 0.848448 by increasing DEPTH to 6. I'll now try decreasing MATRIX_LR to see if more granular updates help, as 0.05 might be slightly aggressive for the increased capacity.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to investigate if a lower learning rate allows for more stable convergence with the increased model depth.
